name: Keeper Ronnaug
title: The Delvers' Rest
examine: Half the chalk tallies on her wall are debts and half are shifts survived, and she guards the difference like a vault. Miners' keeper, miners' banker, miners' memory.
lines: First pour free on a mithril day. Second pour costs double. The mine giveth.
Every pick in that rack outside has a name, and I know whose. You want to make trouble here, start by explaining yourself to the picks.
Grettir sits in the corner and doesn't drink much. Nobody charges him for the chair. That's not kindness, that's arithmetic — he's the reason half of them come home.
